review_scope: Independent static and synthetic-math review of the bounded source-bound F0 residual diagnostic. No model, training, parquet, remote, or production prediction inputs were loaded.

receipt_binding_review.method: Verified each locally available receipt file SHA-256 against INPUTS.json, then ran receipt_validation._validate_receipts against those exact local objects and the manifest's bundle hash and row count.
checks: Extraction bundle hash, byte count, row/group/component counts, fold hash, and wide/deep source pins match the manifest.
Blend-selection metric, bundle, extraction receipt, grade, fold, targets, predictions, row-group array, and component array bindings match.
Independent native grade binds the Q8 prediction hash, paired bundle, selected rows, shape, dtype, finite status, group/component counts, and replay receipt.
Q8 replay binds the validation panel hash, fold hash, official metric, and q8vnni precision label.

math_and_output_review.official_metric: Uses canonical global_wp_clip2_v1, clipping targets and predictions to ±2 and weighting with absolute clipped targets.
math_and_output_review.additive_contributions: Per-bin pooled covariance uses global weighted centers and each target's global Syy/Spp denominator; a fixed partition sums to the official WP. Synthetic checks passed for label and component partitions.
math_and_output_review.calibration: Within-bin covariance and target variance apply the weighted parallel-axis correction to globally centered moments. The prediction-on-target slope is corrected within-bin covariance divided by corrected within-bin target variance; weighted means define the intercept. This is descriptive calibration, not an additive score contribution.
math_and_output_review.csv: The DictWriter field list covers all emitted record fields; the CSV regression test passed.
math_and_output_review.paired_undefined_values: Fixed before final review: undefined weighted-bias and within-regime-rho deltas remain null for zero-weight bins, while additive contribution deltas remain numeric.

validation.initial_failure: Before the fix, the three synthetic tests errored because paired deltas attempted float(None) for zero-weight bins. The failure was reported to the owner.

receipt_contract.command: uv run --no-sync Python snippet loading only the four pinned local JSON receipts and calling _validate_receipts
receipt_contract.result: passed; all four file hashes and cross-receipt bindings matched

validation.staged_import_smoke: Passed --help import smoke in a temporary B/research/campaign_2026-10-18/quality_gap_r1/diagnostics layout with source-a266b036/src pointing to the local canonical src tree and B/src absent.
validation.actual_input_arrays: Not read. The manifest's Linux bundle, Q8 prediction, and fold paths are unavailable on this host by design; remote file sizes and array hashes remain to be checked by the bounded remote entrypoint before analysis.

execution_boundary: This review clears the implementation for the planned bounded source-only retrospective run. It does not verify remote input payload hashes, execute the diagnostic on Beleriand, or make a clean-validation, calibration, blend-selection, or performance claim.
